# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `embarko` MCP server pointing at Embarko's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.embarko.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Embarko user login.
- Logo: the submitted URL `https://embarko.ai/assets/embarko-icon.svg` (not downloaded; embarko.ai was unreachable).
